svg.aria-label: Issue #10: SET Robot (2023–2024). A robot built with UF's SASE Engineering Team. I worked on the electrical side, wiring the robot's electronics: Arduino Uno and Nano controllers, motor drivers for the drive wheels, and the stepper motor and servos that move the arm. I also handled the lidar data processing. Distance and signal-strength frames from a TF-series lidar are read over serial, paired with the stepper's sweep angle, and converted from polar readings into x–y points the navigation code can use.
